product_one_liner.value: Gushwork provides AI marketing agents that help small and midsize businesses get discovered across AI search, Google, and paid channels and generate qualified inbound leads.
product_one_liner.notes: Gushwork's homepage says its AI agents help businesses get discovered across AI search, Google, and paid channels and turn interest into marketing-qualified leads. The homepage description specifies SMBs.

pricing_page.notes: Gushwork has a public pricing page titled “Pricing | Get Inbound Leads from AI Search,” described as offering simple monthly plans.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Gushwork's homepage customer proof names Source Equipment. It also identifies Greg Jones of Midwest Power Products in a customer-results section. | named_customers.0: The homepage customer proof names Source Equipment. | named_customers.1: Gushwork's homepage identifies Midwest Power Products in its customer-results section.

employee_band.notes: A Gushwork job posting describes the company as a team of about 90 people, which falls in the 51-100 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The Gushwork LinkedIn company profile identifies San Francisco as its headquarters city. | hq_country: The Gushwork LinkedIn company profile identifies its headquarters as San Francisco, California, which is in the United States.

founded_year.notes: The Lightspeed company profile identifies Gushwork as founded in 2023.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index describes practical guides on AI search, SEO, lead generation, and marketing. Its displayed posts are marketing-oriented guides and product/visibility content, not engineer-authored posts about how the product is built; this supports false under the stated criteria.

public_docs.notes: The rendered homepage navigation and footer list platform, solutions, pricing, careers, customer, and company links, but no product documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers board lists open job titles, including engineering, implementation, marketing, and sales roles; none of the listed titles is an AI, ML, data-science, or other qualifying role under the specified criteria.

model_provider.notes: A report quotes Gushwork saying it uses Anthropic's model heavily and also uses OpenAI's model; it does not specify particular model names.

compliance_certs.notes: Gushwork's privacy notice includes a security section describing safeguards but does not name any of the listed certifications there. Its GDPR passage describes legal bases for processing personal information, not a claim of GDPR certification or compliance. The certification list is therefore empty.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Gushwork's announcement labels the $9 million round as seed funding. | funding_date: The announcement dates the $9 million seed funding round to February 26, 2026, so the requested YYYY-MM value is 2026-02. | funding_amount_usd: Gushwork's funding announcement states that it raised $9 million in seed funding.

raised_18mo.notes: Gushwork announced its seed round on February 26, 2026, which is within the 18 months before the requested reference date of November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers board lists Account Executive - US Sales and multiple Sales Development Representative and Business Development Representative roles.

launched_6mo.notes: Gushwork announced AI Editor on June 2, 2026, describing a new capability that lets customers update landing pages using plain-English prompts. This is within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available executive-profile evidence did not establish a C-level or VP-level person joining or leaving during the 12 months before 2026-11-09, nor did it provide a sufficiently complete, dated team history to support a negative answer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Gushwork Account Executive job posting names Zoho, HubSpot, and Salesforce as examples of CRM systems for which proficiency is relevant. This is a visible job-post signal, not confirmation that each system is deployed internally. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job posting names Zoho as an example CRM. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job posting names HubSpot as an example CRM. | crm_stack_signal.2: The job posting names Salesforce as an example CRM.
